subject: Taxes
title: The Tampon Tax Debate
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Tampon Tax Debate usable.

hook.text: Most US states tax tampons as non-essential 'luxury' items. Advocates argue this taxes women for biology.

buildup.text: Meanwhile, many states exempt 'necessities' like food and medicine from sales tax. Tampons don't qualify in most states.

discovery.text: By 2024, over 30 states had repealed or reduced the tampon tax after years of activism.

twist.text: Scotland became the first country to provide free period products in 2022.

climax.text: The tampon tax shows how sales tax categories encode cultural assumptions about what counts as essential.

punchline.text: Taxed as luxury, used by necessity. The tampon tax revealed hidden bias.

quiz.question: Which country first provided free period products?
